title: Escalation Routing Rule R-015: Low confidence score under 0.6
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-015 -- Low confidence score under 0.6
TRIGGER TYPE: System Logic
CONDITION: Agent confidence score below 0.60 threshold
ROUTE TO: Front Office and Registration (Extension 1026)
QUEUE: QUEUE_FRONTOFFICE
PRIORITY: NORMAL
SLA: 4.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Ambiguous query that agent cannot resolve with confidence. Route to human triage. Contact Front Office ext. 1026.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: I need that document about the thing from last month
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Can you process the green file for room five?
